leakage_prevention: true and reconstructed versions of the same galaxy remain in the same fold

cnn.architecture: pretrained torchvision MobileNetV2/ResNet-style compact image classifier depending on runtime availability

ensemble.strong_agreement: SVM and CNN agree and both confidence >= 0.60
ensemble.weak_agreement: SVM and CNN agree but one confidence < 0.60
ensemble.disagreement: output uncertain rather than forcing a class
